name: robywire
description: Robywire: a robotics news site built so that every factual sentence traces to a primary source, with a code gate that checks it and the Desk, the pipeline that will write it.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run evals:seeded && npm run fixtures:check && npm run build && npm run audit:prod && npm run build:fixtures && npm run audit && npm run lighthouse
